requirements.title: Coordinated product identity
requirements.statement: Every shipped product carrier shall expose one authoritative semantic product version.
acceptance_criteria: All product carriers equal the authoritative X.Y.Z value.
A product-affecting pull request advances exactly one patch or one minor.

requirements.title: Controlled change record
requirements.statement: Every implementation commit shall update the engineering handoff, and every pull request shall identify requirements, risk, verification, migration, and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Each non-merge commit in the pull request changes HANDOFF.md.
The pull request contains the required change-control sections and evidence.

requirements.title: Frozen serial acquisition contract
requirements.statement: Firmware and trainer shall preserve the 222-column v15.2 wire contract, the original 207-column prefix, and 219-column v15.1 replay compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: The current firmware emits exactly 222 ordered columns.
Legacy 207- and 219-column inputs remain readable without shifting contractual fields.

requirements.title: Private material is not web-served
requirements.statement: TLS keys and other private material shall remain outside public assets and all traversal attempts into private storage shall be denied.
acceptance_criteria: No private-key path resolves through the static asset router.
Private TLS material is ignored by Git and absent from packaged web assets.
Unsupported methods and malformed route segments cannot fall through to filesystem serving or protected handlers.

requirements.title: Blocking dependency vulnerability gate
requirements.statement: Every supported Python, npm, and Rust dependency tree shall be reproducibly audited, and unresolved policy-level vulnerabilities shall fail CI unless a bounded approved exception is recorded.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical Python requirements, all three npm lockfiles, and the Tauri Rust lockfile have no unresolved audit finding at the configured blocking level outside documented bounded exceptions.
Audit failures produce a failing workflow conclusion instead of a successful advisory-only result.
Any exception identifies the advisory, owner, rationale, compensating control, and expiry.

requirements.title: Fail-closed operator credential persistence
requirements.statement: Operator credential mutations shall be atomic and fail closed, authentication lockout state shall not weaken after a persistence failure, and already-issued sessions shall remain usable during an operator-store outage.
acceptance_criteria: Credential-store writes use a validated, flushed temporary file and atomic replacement without a direct-write fallback.
Profile creation and PIN or recovery-code mutation return OPERATOR_STORE_UNAVAILABLE without reporting success when durable persistence fails.
PIN and recovery failures accumulate monotonically in process memory even when each persistence attempt fails.
A previously issued unexpired operator session remains authorized when the profile store later becomes unavailable.

requirements.title: Bounded SSE lifetime and warning
requirements.statement: The trainer shall warn exactly 60 seconds before the 12-hour SSE deadline and the dashboard shall reconnect without clobbering session state.

verification_refs.selector: rotates the one-use SSE token at the stream deadline without clearing session state

acceptance_criteria: The warning event reason and seconds_remaining payload are exact.
Reconnect retains active participant and session identity.

requirements.title: Participant and trial provenance
requirements.statement: Each study capture shall be immutably bound to one pseudonymous participant, trial condition, release identity, protocol identity, and model identity.

verification_refs.selector: fails closed and clears a cached participant when the roster cannot be verified

acceptance_criteria: A started session cannot be reassigned to another participant or condition.
Confirmatory eligibility requires the frozen protocol and complete provenance.
Start remains disabled unless the selected participant is present and active in the current roster.

requirements.title: Cross-release compatibility gate
requirements.statement: Known dashboard, trainer, firmware, protocol-width, or schema mismatches shall block real capture while incomplete legacy evidence remains explicitly unverified.
acceptance_criteria: Every known incompatibility produces a stable blocking decision before capture.
Missing legacy evidence cannot be reported as verified or confirmatory-eligible.

requirements.title: Idempotent session start
requirements.statement: Retries of one Start intent shall allocate and launch at most one session, while reuse with a different request shall be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Same-key same-request retries return one durable session result.
Same-key different-request reuse cannot allocate or alter a session.

requirements.title: Protocol-attempt and completion evidence
requirements.statement: Every planned study attempt shall have an immutable logical-trial identity, a unique attempt record, append-only terminal state, and an auditable participant/no-subject denominator.
acceptance_criteria: Re-analysis cannot mutate capture release, participant, logical trial, or attempt identity.
Failed, stopped, invalid, no-output, and no-subject attempts remain visible in denominators.
Qualified no-subject evidence requires a locked 72 x 150-second protocol, frozen firmware/rules/threshold identity, matching capture provenance, and non-overlapping intervals.
Recruitment, protocol completion, primary independent estimates, withdrawals, and no-subject evidence remain separate denominators with explicit targets and gaps.
Participant withdrawal appends a non-deletion reconciliation tombstone; reversal requires new consent plus authority and evidence references.

requirements.title: Generated dashboard integrity
requirements.statement: The Angular source shall remain authoritative and the committed monolith and native web bundle shall be reproducible from it.

verification_refs.selector: exposes both objectives and both model families

acceptance_criteria: A clean Angular build reproduces the committed dashboard artifact.
No user-facing behavior is added only to the generated monolith.

requirements.title: GBR and experimental 1-D CNN reproducibility
requirements.statement: Gradient boosting shall remain the default model family, 1-D CNN shall be an explicit experimental option, and participant-grouped validation shall fit preprocessing only on training folds.
acceptance_criteria: GBR remains available without the optional CNN dependency.
Participant capture remains model-agnostic unless a verified runtime bundle is active; family selection is recorded by the analysis job.
Confirmatory folds are participant-grouped and leak no preprocessing state from held-out participants.
Every model bundle records family, data, split, feature, hyperparameter, seed, dependency, and source provenance.
LOSO evaluation retains a canonical outer-OOF file with raw and declared post-processed predictions.

requirements.title: Fail-closed pre-collection authorization
requirements.statement: Recruitment, confirmatory capture, confirmatory no-subject evidence, and confirmatory analysis shall remain blocked until a separate dated authorization matches the approved plan, locked protocol, study schema, approvals, withdrawal policy, and physical timing evidence.

verification_refs.selector: blocks recruitment and confirmatory mode when readiness is not authorized

acceptance_criteria: Protocol locked means configuration-frozen and never implies collection authorization.
The default and checked-in state returns 412 STUDY_COLLECTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED before participant, attempt, idempotency, reservation, session, or analysis mutation.
The calendar records 40 recruited, 38 protocol-complete, at least 19 primary independent estimates, and 72 x 150-second no-subject captures with owners, proposed dates, and abort criteria.
Withdrawal treatment remains pending REC/privacy review and the plaintext system never claims cryptographic erasure.
Alignment outputs state method, numeric uncertainty, limitations, and missing physical latency evidence without changing the serial contract.

requirements.title: Predeclared statistical analysis
requirements.statement: Confirmatory RMSE, TOST, repeated-measures agreement, coverage, and exact false-alarm analyses shall use versioned predeclared inputs and participant-balanced outputs.

verification_refs.selector: Statistical interpretation rule and manuscript integration review

acceptance_criteria: Equivalence margins, alpha, hierarchy, aggregation, and exclusions are fixed before confirmatory evaluation.
Outputs retain participant, trial, session, prediction, coverage, and uncertainty denominators.
The Objective 3 exact result is produced only from exactly 72 unique, non-overlapping, protocol-qualified no-subject captures.
Every confirmatory run keeps run product, analysis-plan ID and digest, study-protocol ID, and study-session schema identities separate and validated.
Draft requirements and plans may prepare software gates but cannot authorize recruitment, confirmatory collection, evaluation, exclusion, or manuscript claims.
A non-significant difference test is never reported as equivalence.

requirements.title: Reproducible authorized release
requirements.statement: Every published release shall bind the approved source commit, controlled-document revision, verification evidence, final artifact hashes, signing state, authorization, and rollback strategy.
acceptance_criteria: The release tag product version matches the authoritative source version.
Hashes describe the final published bytes after signing.
Production authorization requires a signed Android release, an Authenticode-verified Windows installer, and a detached Tauri updater signature.
Before updater signature_state=signed is emitted, the detached updater signature is cryptographically verified against the configured public key and staged final EXE bytes.
Transient NSIS dependency-download failures are retried a bounded number of times before Windows packaging fails.
Every publication is intentional, rejects an existing Release or different-SHA tag before native builds, and records successful exact-source protected-workflow evidence.
Android, Windows, and authorized Pages assembly consume one round-trip-verified release web bundle.
The protected aggregate includes pinned firmware compilation and an installed-wheel console-entrypoint gate.
Authorization and any external or skipped gate are explicit in the release record.
Existing tags and release assets are never overwritten during rollback.

requirements.title: Reproducibility and manuscript feedback loop
requirements.statement: Hardware, firmware, trainer, dashboard, GBR, experimental 1-D CNN, statistics, and manuscript outputs shall remain connected by one controlled reproducibility process.

verification_refs.selector: Physical test execution and manuscript integration review

acceptance_criteria: The diagram names the current product and protocol identity without implying firmware CNN inference.
Every model and statistical output has a defined manuscript destination and reproducibility record.

requirements.title: Hardware and subsystem design
requirements.statement: Radar-sensing, temperature-sensing, embedded-inference, and alert subsystems shall be designed with a KiCad PCB layout providing single-carrier power and signal interconnect.
acceptance_criteria: KiCad PCB layout defines power-supply net and headers for MR60BHA2, MLX90614, and ESP32-C6.
Design verified via ERC and breadboard bring-up before fabrication commitment.

requirements.title: Enclosure build and form-factor trade-off analysis
requirements.statement: Enclosure shall be fabricated via FDM 3D printing in PETG/ABS with a documented trade-off analysis between handheld-scanner and tripod-mounted form factors selecting tripod mounting for validation.
acceptance_criteria: Trade-off analysis compares handheld vs tripod across 6 operational criteria.
Tripod mount selected for bench accuracy validation; 1/4-20 mount insert integrated.

requirements.title: Subsystem integration and staged firmware chain
requirements.statement: MR60BHA2 radar, XIAO ESP32-C6, MLX90614, LCD/buzzer, and GBR C branch-comparison inference shall integrate into a single firmware unit with staged module bring-up.

verification_refs.selector: Compile default and gated BLE firmware

acceptance_criteria: Firmware compiles cleanly for XIAO ESP32-C6 without external ML runtime.
Staged bring-up validates raw UART, I2C temperature, FIR/FFT features, GBR inference, and UI.

requirements.title: Controlled 10-configuration validation protocol
requirements.statement: Prototype RR and HR accuracy, agreement, and valid-output rate shall be tested against human references across 10 randomized configurations (0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 m with and without cardboard).
acceptance_criteria: Protocol defines 10 confirmatory conditions, 30 trials per complete participant, 1,140 minimum captures.
Temperature evaluation restricted to 0.6 m unobstructed; false alarms evaluated over 72 no-subject trials.
